description: The bar chart presents sample counts for four text types split into two categories, “Open” and “Cons.”, to show how many samples are available for each genre under each category. The horizontal axis contains the text-type categories in left-to-right order: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, while the vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Sample Count” on a linear scale starting at 0 and extending to at least 130, with regularly spaced tick marks every 20 units. For each text type, two adjacent bars are shown: a light blue bar for “Open” and a light pink bar for “Cons.” (as indicated by the legend near the top). The Argumentative group shows an Open bar labeled 79 and a Cons. bar labeled 122; the Narrative group shows an Open bar labeled 80 and a Cons. bar labeled 87; the Descriptive group shows an Open bar labeled 68 and a Cons. bar labeled 100; and the Expository group shows an Open bar labeled 62 and a Cons. bar labeled 130. Numeric value labels are printed above each bar, the bars are grouped by text type rather than sorted by height, and no additional visual emphasis (such as outlines or annotations beyond the value labels) is used.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the sample count for different text types across two categories: 'Open' and 'Cons.' The X-axis represents the categories of text types, labeled as 'Argumentative,' 'Narrative,' 'Descriptive,' and 'Expository.' The Y-axis represents the sample count, labeled 'Sample Count,' with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 120, marked at intervals of 20. Each text type category contains a pair of bars: one light blue representing 'Open' and one light pink representing 'Cons.' In the 'Argumentative' category, the light blue bar for 'Open' has a value of approximately 79, while the light pink bar for 'Cons.' reaches about 122. The 'Narrative' category shows the light blue bar at approximately 80 and the light pink bar at around 87. For 'Descriptive' texts, the light blue bar measures about 68, and the light pink bar is marked at 120. In the 'Expository' category, the light blue bar has a value of about 62, contrasted by the light pink bar at 130. The 'Narrative' category shows the most consistent sample counts between 'Open' and 'Cons.' categories, while the 'Expository' category demonstrates the steepest increase in sample count between the two categories. The bars are grouped by text type and do not appear to be sorted in a specific order. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding for 'Open' and 'Cons.' noted in the chart's legend.
